title: VaultSealAdapter
responsibility: Seal, open and sign credential vault envelopes with the broker's X25519, HKDF, ChaCha20-Poly1305 and P-256 algorithms.

inputs.name: VaultSealAdapter.hash.bytes
inputs.description: Bytes to digest.

inputs.name: VaultSealAdapter.keyFingerprint.publicKey
inputs.description: Base64url public key.

inputs.name: VaultSealAdapter.deviceSigningInput.origin
inputs.description: Approval origin the phone signs for.

inputs.name: VaultSealAdapter.deviceSigningInput.path
inputs.description: Device route path, such as /v1/device/requests.

inputs.name: VaultSealAdapter.deviceSigningInput.proof
inputs.description: Device id, nonce and base64url payload of the proof.

inputs.name: VaultSealAdapter.approvalSigningInput.origin
inputs.description: Approval origin the phone signs for.

inputs.name: VaultSealAdapter.approvalSigningInput.proof
inputs.description: Device id, nonce and base64url decision payload.

inputs.name: VaultSealAdapter.approvalSigningInput.binding
inputs.description: Recipe digest, runner fingerprint, method, mode and lease length the broker recorded for the request.

inputs.name: VaultSealAdapter.signingKey.encoded
inputs.description: Uncompressed P-256 public key, 65 bytes, base64url.

inputs.name: VaultSealAdapter.isAuthentic.key
inputs.description: Pinned P-256 verification key.

inputs.name: VaultSealAdapter.isAuthentic.input
inputs.description: Signing input from deviceSigningInput or approvalSigningInput.

inputs.name: VaultSealAdapter.isAuthentic.signature
inputs.description: Base64url IEEE P1363 ECDSA signature.

inputs.name: VaultSealAdapter.seal.recipientPublicKey
inputs.description: Recipient X25519 public key, base64url.

inputs.name: VaultSealAdapter.seal.requestId
inputs.description: Request id, used as the AEAD associated data.

inputs.name: VaultSealAdapter.seal.plaintext
inputs.description: Bytes to seal.

inputs.name: VaultSealAdapter.open.privateKey
inputs.description: Recipient X25519 private key.

inputs.name: VaultSealAdapter.open.requestId
inputs.description: Request id the envelope was sealed for.

inputs.name: VaultSealAdapter.open.sealed
inputs.description: Sender public key, salt and ciphertext with its tag.

outputs.name: VaultSealAdapter.keyFingerprint
outputs.description: Hex SHA-256 of the decoded key bytes.

outputs.name: VaultSealAdapter.deviceSigningInput
outputs.description: The CB-DEVICE-V1 lines: version, origin, path, device id, nonce and payload digest.

outputs.name: VaultSealAdapter.approvalSigningInput
outputs.description: The V1 lines headed CB-DEVICE-V2, followed by recipe digest, runner fingerprint, method and <mode>:<leaseMs>.

outputs.name: VaultSealAdapter.isAuthentic
outputs.description: True when the signature verifies over the input.

outputs.name: VaultSealAdapter.seal
outputs.description: The envelope: an ephemeral sender key, a random salt and ChaCha20-Poly1305 ciphertext.

outputs.name: VaultSealAdapter.open
outputs.description: The decrypted plaintext; the derived key is zeroed afterwards.

outputs.name: VaultSealAdapter.runnerKey
outputs.description: A fresh X25519 runner key with its fingerprint and an open() that works once.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: 'Invalid device key.' when an enrolled signing key is not a 65-byte uncompressed P-256 point.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: 'Invalid X25519 agreement.' when the recipient key yields an all-zero shared secret.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown by node:crypto when the recipient public key is not a valid X25519 key.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: 'Could not open the phone approval.' for any key, tag or decoding failure, so nothing about the cause leaks.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: 'The runner key was already used.' when the returned key's open() is called a second time.
